name: Imperial Porcelain Small Plate
where: Imperial Porcelain factory shop, Obukhovskoy Oborony
about: A small plate made in St. Petersburg, where the Imperial Porcelain factory has produced fine porcelain for generations.
tip: Check the mark on the base to confirm it is genuine.

name: Palekh Lacquer Miniature Box
where: Reputable Russian craft shops, Nevsky Prospekt
about: A small box painted in Russian miniature style, a folk craft that St. Petersburg shops sell alongside work from other regions.
tip: Look for a signature, the artist's name, and hand-painted details. Finely detailed pieces cost more.
